questions: Did you have any hives, itching, or lip/tongue swelling at the time the symptoms started?
answers: Yes, I had itching (about 6/10) and there were pink skin lesions/redness, including areas on my right biceps and around my mouth/thyroid cartilage and both ankles. I did not have any swelling of my lips or tongue, and my rash swelling is 0/10.
